title: Thekkady Travel Guide - Best Places to Visit in Kerala’s Wildlife Paradise
content:
Thekkady - Kerala’s Wildlife Paradise

Thekkady, located in the Idukki district of Kerala, is one of the best destinations for nature lovers, wildlife enthusiasts, and adventure seekers. Famous for the Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary, spice plantations, and scenic beauty, Thekkady is a must-visit place for those who want to experience Kerala’s wild side.

Click here for Thekkady Package

Here’s why Thekkady should be on your travel list:

Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary - Thekkady is home to elephants, tigers, gaur, and rare birds. A boat ride in Periyar Lake gives you a chance to spot wildlife in their natural habitat.
Elephant Rides & Bamboo Rafting - Unique experiences like jungle trekking, elephant rides, and bamboo rafting make Thekkady an adventure hub.
Spice Plantations - Thekkady is surrounded by plantations of cardamom, pepper, cinnamon, and coffee, where visitors can take guided tours.
Adventure Activities - Trekking, nature walks, border hiking, and jeep safaris attract thrill-seekers.
Culture & Traditions - Watch traditional Kerala art forms like Kathakali and Kalaripayattu (martial arts) at cultural centers in Thekkady.
Shopping - Thekkady is also famous for authentic Kerala spices, handicrafts, and souvenirs.

Best Places to Visit in Thekkady

Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary & Lake - For boat cruises and wildlife spotting.
Spice Plantations - Learn about Kerala’s aromatic spices.
Mangala Devi Temple - Ancient temple with scenic views.
Kumily - A small town near Thekkady, popular for shopping and local experiences.
Chellarkovil Viewpoint - Offers breathtaking views of waterfalls and valleys.

Best Time to Visit Thekkady

October to February - Cool and pleasant, perfect for sightseeing and wildlife tours.
March to May - Warm but good for spice plantation visits.
June to September - Monsoon season, ideal for greenery and photography.

Things to Do in Thekkady

  • Take a boat cruise in Periyar Lake.
  • Enjoy bamboo rafting and jungle trekking.
  • Visit a spice plantation and buy fresh spices.
  • Watch Kathakali dance and Kalaripayattu shows.
  • Stay in a treehouse or jungle resort for a unique experience.
excerpt: Thekkady is a perfect blend of wildlife, adventure, culture, and natural beauty. Whether you want to explore Kerala’s spice trails, enjoy thrilling activities, or simply relax in the lap of nature, Thekkady promises an unforgettable journey.
